summary: EarthGuard is an AI-powered environmental monitoring platform that uses satellite data to understand changes in Earth's environment. It aims to help users explore climate patterns, monitor vegetation changes, and understand environmental risks through simple visualizations. The project makes Earth observation data easier to understand and encourages awareness of climate change and environmental protection. By combining satellite information with interactive web technologies, EarthGuard helps people make informed decisions for a sustainable future.
details: EarthGuard is a web-based platform designed to make Earth observation and climate information easier to understand. It uses NASA satellite imagery and climate data to help users explore environmental changes. The platform aims to provide: 1. Satellite imagery visualization to observe changes on Earth. 2. Climate information such as temperature and solar radiation. 3. Interactive charts to understand environmental patterns. 4. Location-based exploration of environmental information. 5. An easy-to-use interface for students and the public. The project can be developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, and data visualization tools. NASA GIBS services can provide satellite imagery, while NASA POWER provides meteorological and solar data. The main goal is to improve environmental awareness and make NASA Earth science information accessible to everyone.
